items.question: Into which locus does the radiance situated in the throat-cavity attain absorption?
premises: A radiance is situated in the throat-cavity.
This radiance goes to a state of absorption.
The locus of this absorption is the brahma-aperture.
items.inference: The radiance situated in the throat-cavity attains absorption in the brahma-aperture.
uncertainties: The grammatical subject of gatā is not explicitly stated in this verse and is inferred from context.
items.plain_english: The radiance situated in the cavity of the throat has gone to absorption in the brahma-aperture.
